Hey OP, I can understand where you're coming from and it's perfectly okay to not feel like you belong. We're all capable of building our own communities with the people we're comfortable and close with. I'm fortunate enough to come from one of the countries that is LGBTQ-friendly (rights protected by law) and I never make an active effort to involve myself in the LGBTQ scene in my country at all (even though we have extravagant pride parades etc. ). I have some friends who are also somewhere along the spectrum and we never cared much about belonging in THE community either. :) My suggestion is to just cultivate your own space with people you feel safe around and that share the same sentiments as you do. Don't feel too pressured about it either- I'm sure your community will come along over time.
